content: Insist on yourself; never imitate. Your own gift you can present every moment with the cumulative force of a whole life's cultivation.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Imitation is spiritual suicide because it rejects the unique lens through which the universe seeks to express itself through you. Cultivating your natural gifts yields an unborrowed authority.
practicalInsight: Stop copying the formula of others; double down on the specific qualities and instincts that are uniquely yours.
reflectionPrompt: What natural talent or voice have you neglected while attempting to emulate someone else?
